title: Showmanship tricks and end of reel
summary: Allen asks about stage tricks to attract attention; Albert never needed them. The reel ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Well, I have noticed, I guess the tape's about to run out and I want to get in the middle of it, but we'll just have to stop. But I've noticed some showmanship and some of the big bands and some of the singers, they'll pull like an act right in the middle of something to create some sort of excitement. I see people faint, you know, they'll call the doctor in.
Well, fortunately I never had to do anything like that.
You never did have to do any tricks at all. No, no, no fix. Yeah, but I, well, that's the end of the reel.
